question: A takes 15 days to complete (5)/(7) of a work. With the help of B, they finish the whole work in 12 days. In how many days, B alone will complete the same work
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete 5/7 of work = 15 days

Time taken by both together to complete work = 12 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

A completes (5)/(7) of the work in 15 days

He will complete the total work in = 15 × (7/2) = 21 days

Let the efficiency of A be x

Total work = 21 × x = 21x

Now, A and B together complete the work in 12 days

So, the efficiency of (A + B) = 21x/12 = 1.75x

So, the efficiency of B = 1.75x - x = 0.75x

Now, the time taken by B to complete the task alone 

⇒ 21x/0.75x = 28 days

**∴ B alone will complete the same work in 28 days.**
